kjv-en.text: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

kjv-en.text: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

webc-en.text: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

verseRulings.name: Judah
verseRulings.why: “the sons of Judah: Pharez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur and Shobal” — a tribal genealogy that includes later descendants, not the patriarch’s own sons. The blind reviewers of KJV, BSB and WEBC would link the patriarch; policy: ancestor of a genealogy is linked only when the text makes the man himself the subject.

verseRulings.name: the James in “Judas the brother/son of James”
verseRulings.why: The text does not say which James (Alphaeus’ or the Lord’s brother). Undecided ⇒ NONE.

verseRulings.name: Christ
verseRulings.why: Impostors use the title (“I am Christ”, “Lo, here is Christ”); it is not a reference to Jesus. Generic uses that name the expected Messiah of the real Jesus story (Luke 3:15, John 1:20, 1:25, 3:28 …) stay linked.

verseRulings.name: David
verseRulings.why: “seed of David”, “sons of David” as dynasty/family, “sepulchres of the sons of David”, a clan in Ezra 8:2 — same treatment as “house of David”.

verseRulings.name: Jacob
verseRulings.why: “the heritage of Jacob thy father” — the people’s inheritance (policy addendum 2). One audit and two blind reviewers read it as the patriarch; the record keeps it unlinked in all four editions for consistency.

verseRulings.name: Cain (Tubal-Cain)
verseRulings.why: A descendant of Lamech, not Adam’s son.

verseRulings.name: Nahum
verseRulings.why: An ancestor in Jesus’s genealogy, not the prophet Nahum.

verseRulings.name: Augustus
verseRulings.why: The emperor of Acts 25 is Nero; “Augustus’ band” (27:1) is a cohort. Only Luke 2:1 is Caesar Augustus.

verseRulings.name: Rahab
verseRulings.why: A poetic name for Egypt / the sea monster, not the woman of Jericho.

verseRulings.name: Solomon (Solomon’s porch / colonnade)
verseRulings.why: A place named for him. Now unlinked identically in all editions.

verseRulings.name: Jeremiah
verseRulings.why: “Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah” — Hamutal’s father, not the prophet (2 Kings 23:31 and 24:18 were already unlinked).

verseRulings.name: Adam (“the last Adam”, “sons of Adam”)
verseRulings.why: Type/humankind uses. 1 Cor 15:45 “the first man Adam” stays linked.

verseRulings.name: the temple
verseRulings.why: “I saw no temple therein” and “the temple of Babylon” are not the Jerusalem temple. (Exodus 23:19 was already dropped.)

verseRulings.name: Saul
verseRulings.why: “After removing Saul, He raised up David” is King Saul; the old rule sent it to Paul in BSB.

verseRulings.name: Judas … Iscariot
verseRulings.why: Epithet form in all four editions.

verseRulings.name: Messiah/Messias
verseRulings.why: Andrew’s “We have found the Messiah” names Jesus. John 4:25 (the Samaritan woman’s general expectation), Daniel 9:25–26 and Matthew 1:23 “Immanuel” are **not** linked.

verseRulings.name: Shemuel
verseRulings.why: KJV spelling of Samuel; Numbers 34:20 and 1 Chr 7:2 are other men.

verseRulings.name: David’s city/tower/tent; X’s house (David, Saul, Ahab, Eli, Joab …); “house of your servant David”; “city of his father David”; “like that of Jeroboam”; “house and lineage/family of X”
verseRulings.why: So that KJV “house of X”/“city of David” and WEB/WEBC “X’s house”/“David’s city” and BSB “city of his father David” all behave the same way. Literal residences stay linked: 1 Samuel 19:11 and Psalm 59:1 “David’s house”.

verseRulings.name: Levi
verseRulings.why: Levi the tax collector (identified with Matthew by the Matt 9:9 parallel; see Contested).
